title: Implement Automatic HTTPS Redirection
description: This feature matters as it ensures secure communication between the client and server by automatically redirecting HTTP requests to HTTPS, improving security and preventing mixed content warnings. It does this by adding a middleware function that checks the request protocol and redirects to HTTPS if necessary. This enhances the overall security of the yantraverse framework
testCases: Test HTTP request redirects to HTTPS
Test HTTPS request is not redirected
acceptance: The feature is accepted when all test cases pass and the redirection works as expected for both HTTP and HTTPS requests
reason: Implementing automatic HTTPS redirection is a high-impact feature that improves the security and usability of the yantraverse framework, aligning with the framework's focus on security and stability
